title: Nonlinear DRN training configuration
description: Training configuration for the standalone nonlinear-DRN paper artifact. Editable defaults compose dataset/training choices with a simulator profile; saved and paper configurations may contain the fully expanded simulator settings inline.

$schema.description: Editor-facing link to this JSON Schema. It is ignored by the training runtime.

description.description: Human-readable purpose and provenance of this configuration.

source.description: Optional provenance note identifying the historical runs or assets from which the configuration was audited.

simulator_profile.description: Repository-relative path to a simulator profile inside this repository. Source templates use this instead of inline simulator fields.

simulator_profile_source.description: Provenance recorded in an expanded configuration: the simulator-profile path from which the inline fields were loaded.

simulator_profile_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the simulator profile recorded when a composed source is expanded.

dataset.description: Dataset selection and preprocessing. MNIST is downloaded only when --download is supplied.

num_samples.description: Optional deterministic prefix size; null uses all samples.

train_fraction.description: Fraction assigned to the deterministic training split.

root.description: Repository-relative or absolute MNIST storage directory.

normalize.description: Apply the configured mean, standard deviation, and final scale.

normalize_mean.description: Mean subtracted before input duplication and input gain.

normalize_scale.description: Multiplier applied after standardization; the paper accuracy runs use 0.3.

layer_shapes.description: Input, hidden, and output tensor shapes. Inputs are signed-duplicated; double-Shockley and PWL outputs use paired nodes.

non_linearity.description: Grounded nonlinear element: one Shockley diode, antiparallel double Shockley diode, or measured/PWL I-V data.

weight_gains.description: One initialization gain per conductance matrix.

weight_min.description: Lower conductance bound enforced after optimizer steps.

weight_max.description: Upper conductance bound enforced after optimizer steps.

weight_init_mode.description: Conductance initialization rule; paper presets use kaiming_uniform.

input_gain.description: Dimensionless multiplier applied after preprocessing and signed input duplication.

exponential_diode_param.description: Shockley parameters. Active only for single_diode_exponential and double_diode_exponential.

I_s.description: Reverse saturation current in the simulator's electrical units.

iv_data_path.description: Measured/PWL .npz file containing either iv or paired i and v arrays. Active only for experimental.

num_iterations.description: Fixed coordinate-descent sweeps per free or nudged equilibrium because adaptive_equilibrium is false.

learning_rates.description: Rates in optimizer parameter order: all conductance tensors, followed by hidden biases.

scheduler_gamma.description: Multiplicative learning-rate decay applied after every epoch; 1 disables decay.

nudging.description: Magnitude of the equilibrium-propagation nudging coefficient.

minimizer_impl.description: Archived compatibility selector. The value resolves to model.resistive.minimizer.QuadraticMinimizer; there is no separate custom minimizer module.

mode.description: Layer update ordering; paper presets use asynchronous odd-even updates.

single_diode_updater.description: Updater selected when non_linearity is single_diode_exponential; otherwise inactive.

double_diode_updater.description: Double-Shockley updater, or standard/overrelaxed measured-PWL updater when non_linearity is experimental.

overrelaxation_factor.description: SOR-style factor omega used only by updater names containing overrelaxed; 1 gives an unrelaxed update.

adaptive_equilibrium.description: Must be false for training. Every phase performs exactly num_iterations sweeps.

rel_tol.description: Relative early-stop tolerance. Retained for compatibility but inactive while adaptive_equilibrium is false.

vn_tol.description: Absolute voltage early-stop tolerance. Retained for compatibility but inactive while adaptive_equilibrium is false.

use_polish.description: Run Newton residual-correction steps after the Lambert-W estimate for custom Shockley updaters.

max_newton_iters.description: Maximum Shockley Newton-polish iterations; inactive when use_polish is false and always inactive for measured/PWL.

z_thresh.description: Lambert-W branch threshold. Use the backend for z <= z_thresh and a four-term large-z asymptotic expansion above it; this does not clip z.

exp_clip.description: Absolute clamp on exponent arguments used to construct z and, when enabled, Newton residuals. Active only for custom Shockley updaters.

damping.description: Multiplier on measured/PWL Newton steps; active only for experimental.

experimental_newton_max_steps.description: Maximum measured/PWL Newton steps per coordinate update; active only for experimental.

experimental_newton_tol.description: Absolute voltage-change stopping tolerance for measured/PWL Newton iterations; active only for experimental.

seed.description: Random seed for initialization, data split, and loader order.

expected_results.description: Optional audited outcome metadata; never used as a training input.

runner.description: Provenance added to configurations expanded by repro.runner.

oneOf.title: Fully expanded or paper training configuration
